title: Proyecto-TGA: Comparativa de Entrenamiento en CPU vs GPU (CUDA)
summary: A student project comparing CPU vs GPU (CUDA) training performance for a KNN classifier on the Iris dataset, benchmarking manual CPU/CUDA implementations against cuML. A separate script, iris_data_generator.py, uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic augmented Iris data.
needs: unclear whether generated data feeds into the main CUDA/CPU comparison notebooks or is a standalone side script
